ClsFunction.Name: Run
ClsFunction.Body:
<DisplayName("اجراي فرمول")> Public Function Run() As clsOut Try If Info8.GetAccountingDocCreateParameter.AccountingDocumentingCause = CByte(BIZ.SA.ClsEnum.EumAccountingDocumentingCause.Confirm) Then If Info8.GetAccountingDocCreateParameter.ObjOnPrice = BIZ.SA.ClsEnum.EumObjOnPrice.Income Then Call iNcOME() Call IncomeHoushmand() Call IncomeSrvElectronic() Call iNcOMESeprdeh() Call iNcOMEEshghal() Call iNcOMEGhatar_Shahri() Call iNcOMEBackSeprdeh() Call iNcOMEOragh() Call iNcOMEHavaleT() Call BazAfarine() Call Tahator1() Call Tahator() Else Call Nosazi() End If ElseIf Info8.GetAccountingDocCreateParameter.AccountingDocumentingCause = 7 Then Call iNcOMECheck() End If Catch ex As Exception End Try End Function
